stage1.impression: A legible, well-composed night scene: the six coloured rims read at once against dark gabled houses and the canal, and the work feels specific to Amsterdam. But it is plainly a render. The facades are flat untextured planes with identical grid windows and flat-filled 'blinds', the paving has no joints, the sky is a saturated blue gradient, and the near-left paving is lit brighter than the spot's coloured shadow. A jury would see a clear concept in a generic CG place, not a photograph of the work in situ.

blocking_9: Houses across the canal must read as real brick with varied facades (window frames with depth, curtains and interiors, varied heights and colours), not repeated flat planes with flat-fill blinds
Quay paving must show real setts or clinker brick with joints, wear and damp sheen at 1:1
The coloured shadow pool must be the brightest ground in frame, and warmer in tone than it is now: today the near-left paving (median 163) outshines the pool (median ~100)
Sky must be a believable urban night sky (dark, desaturated, warm city glow near the horizon), not a saturated royal-blue gradient
Rims must show their specified colours unmistakably; the violet meridian currently reads pale lavender-white and the orange reads peach
Some sign of life near the work (a passer-by, a parked bicycle actually visible, wet reflections of the rims on the paving or in the water)

defects.what: Facades are flat untextured planes, no brick, no cornice detail; windows repeat one module; lit windows are flat colour fills with hard-edged 'blind' rectangles, no interiors or curtains
Sky saturated blue (b_median 90 vs r 36), CG gradient, no city glow
Near-left paving over-lit by the street lamp (median 163), brighter than the hero spot pool; draws the eye away from the work
Paving is a smooth plane with no setts, joints or wear; reads as a showroom floor
Spot pool is cold 5000 K against a 3500 K grade, reads bluish-white; the coloured shadow is faint and muddy (median ~100)
Violet meridian reads pale lavender / near white; orange meridian reads peach, colours not distinct
Canal water is a smooth dark mirror with smeared reflections of windows; no rim colours reflected, no ripple
Barrier rope ring is a thin uniform CG tube, reads as a wire diagram rather than a festival barrier
Distant figure is a featureless silhouette stand-in
Only one bollard clearly visible though card lists 6; street props sparse; the bicycle is not readable

changes.problem: The houses across the canal read as CG blocks: flat planes, one repeated window module, flat-fill lit windows.

evidence.measured: 3x crop: uniform brown plane with no texture; lit windows are flat cream or tan fills with hard horizontal 'blind' edges

change.setting: materials' finish of the houses (brick) and the lit windows
change.from: flat brown plane, windows as flat emissive fills, 0.32 lit at glow 0.1
change.to: dark red-brown brick texture with mortar joints at real scale, white-painted frames with 5-8 cm depth, window interiors with curtains, lamps and a warm 2700 K gradient; lower lit share to ~0.25 and vary glow per window 0.05-0.15

changes.expected: Facade texture visible at 1:1; window brightness varies; the facades read as a real canal frontage

changes.problem: The street lamp floods the near-left paving brighter than the hero spot's coloured shadow, so the eye goes to an empty corner.

change.to: 2 x point, 60 W, 2700 K (or lift the near lamp's height so its pool falls further away)

changes.expected: Near-left paving falls to a warm mid-tone, 70-100; the spot pool becomes the brightest ground

changes.problem: The coloured shadow pool is too weak and too cold to be the second hero: faint, bluish-white and muddy.

evidence.measured: lum_median 99.6, b_median 110 > r_median 106 against a 3500 K grade

change.to: 1400 W, 4000 K, cone 14 deg, aimed at [0.6, -1.6, 0.0] so the shadow lands fully on dry paving inside the barrier

changes.expected: Pool median 130-170 with saturated coloured bands from the discs, neutral to warm white edge

changes.problem: The quay paving is a smooth plane with no joints or wear, which gives the render away.

evidence.measured: 3x crop: continuous gradient with no pattern; lum_range in flat areas is lighting only

change.setting: materials' finish of the quay (paving, stone kerb)
change.to: grey-brown clinker or basalt setts ~10 x 20 cm in herringbone with dark joints, roughness 0.5-0.8 varied, a few damp patches with roughness 0.15; granite kerb with chipped arris

changes.expected: Joint pattern visible at 1:1; damp patches pick up the rims' colours as soft reflections

changes.problem: The sky is a saturated blue CG gradient, not an urban night sky.

change.to: strength 0.04, desaturated slate blue-grey with a warm sodium/LED glow over the rooftops; haze 0.004 to 0.006 per metre

changes.expected: Sky reads dark and near neutral, blue only slightly above red

changes.problem: The violet and orange rims do not read as their colours; the violet is near white and the orange is peach, so the six-colour idea weakens.

evidence.measured: 3x crop: violet meridian renders pale lavender-white with a bright core; orange meridian renders pale peach

change.to: 0.12, with clamp 10 -> 6 so cores stop desaturating under AgX; keep the disc colours as fixed

changes.expected: Each rim holds saturated colour along its length; violet clearly purple, orange clearly orange

changes.problem: The canal is a dead mirror: no ripple, and none of the rims' colour reaches the water.

evidence.measured: lum_median 20.5; reflections are smooth vertical smears of windows only

change.to: fine wind ripple (2-5 cm normal noise, slight anisotropy along the canal), roughness 0.05; reflections broken into horizontal streaks

changes.expected: Window and lamp reflections break into lively streaks; water reads as water

changes.problem: The street is empty and the props read as diagram: thin wire barrier, one visible bollard, a silhouette figure.

evidence.measured: rope is a uniform thin tube; bicycle not legible; figure at [910,480,950,550] featureless

change.from: low barrier ring with thin rope, 3 figures across the water, 1 bicycle
change.to: thicker matte rope with sag between posts, a bicycle parked visibly against the left bollard, two passers-by on the near quay at 6-10 m (slight motion blur), a bench

changes.expected: Scale and life read at a glance; the work sits in a used place

out_of_scope.request: None of the globe's design needs changing for this frame
out_of_scope.why: The globe's discs, colours, tilt, size and rim lighting are fixed by the card; only their emission level is touched (c6)

out_of_scope.request: The brief's reference board (listening bar, acrylic in an interior, the EARF speaker) does not match this image
out_of_scope.why: The card defines an outdoor festival-entry frame; I judged against photographic realism of night exteriors and the card's purpose, and ignored the interior-specific criteria
